title: BO-000001: natural quantity correction mutates the real cart deterministically, no LLM needed
notes: The real production bug (order BO-000001): 'make it 3 Buddies instead of 1' has none of ORDER_ADD's trigger words (add/plus/another/extra), so intent_router returns None/UNKNOWN. Previously this fell through entirely to the LLM, which sometimes failed to return a cart-mutating action at all. This fixture proves the new deterministic guard (_detect_quantity_correction, pipeline.py) now resolves this exact phrasing WITHOUT any LLM call -- no 'llm' key is present on the turn below; if the pipeline ever fell through to the LLM for this message, the replay framework's own DEAD LLM SCRIPT / unscripted-LLM-call integrity checks would fail this test.

turns.message: I'll have a coke and 2 chips
